text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Wonder Acute mentions that 
she'd like to become a dirt racing 
storyteller once she retires. It seems she 
wants to pass down the legend of Smart 
Falcon's greatness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing it was too early for her to 
retire, her Trainer presented her next 
goal: the JBC Classic. Although she 
agreed, the fire within her was already on 
the verge of burning out...
